caption: The drawing presents a technical illustration of a chair rendered in fine black lines on a beige or cream background. The composition consists of two main views of the same chair: a front view on the left and a side view on the right. The front view shows the chair’s overall symmetrical design, with a wide, curved backrest, narrowed waist, and four outward-curving legs. The seat, backrest, and decorative features are outlined clearly, including inward curves on the back and seat. The side view displays the chair’s profile, highlighting the curved backrest, a thick cushioned seat, a gently sloping back, and two legs—one front and one back—showing their curvature and detailing. Measurement lines and a scale are marked in the drawing, with dimensions indicated above the chair in the front view. The entire drawing is set within a rectangular boundary, with additional labels and scales at the bottom edge for reference. No color is used other than the black outlines and the background tone.
title: Chair
